title: Bound fixed Type B two-return providers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Check the two fixed Type B odd returns at caller clocks 1339 and 2970. A literal 4,783-event incidence scan and an independent emitter-source trace agree that no retained odd-in-q operation reaches either erased return. Across eight ports and all four phases, the physical sign correction is q², while the two required returns have opposite-sign difference of rank two.

In the stated canonical tensor model with fixed fibres, an even erased map, and volume-linear tariff, both rank-16 and rank-18 packed cores need about 1.25 field volumes. The directed affordability uppers are about 1.12736 and 1.00253. The width-eight obstruction bounds every width m ≥ 8. Both complete margins are negative even with ancillary costs granted free.

## Task and overlap

Use [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7394](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7394) excludes a single projected return. This package grants two returns and checks the fixed source incidences and capacity price. The package is the only new research commit, stacked on the existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-fixed-type-b-two-return-provider-bound/replay.py
```

Clean replay regenerates the quote and two independent 32-case incidence receipts. Three altered inputs reject. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, navigation and official Git-free export replay passed locally. The exact source atlas records width 73, while the proof uses width 8 as an analytic extremum. The initial width assertion and correction are recorded. No provider was built after the price gate failed.

## Credit

#7334 and #7113 supply the literal inputs. #7295 supplies the contact inventory, #7394 the one-return exclusion, #7357 and #7298 the signed quote, and #7344 the displacement method. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed odd-in-q erased map or a noncanonical packing would need a new literal source and return binding, an exact signed proof and a fully charged tariff.
